blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Easterlies, or the warm winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, will be the prevailing weather system affecting the rest of the country on Wednesday, Nov. 18, according to the state weather bureau. In its 5 p.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that the easterlies may bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Quezon, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Surigao del Sur, and Davao Oriental.
